Supply chain disruptions and commodity price inflation may impact the availability and cost of raw materials, particularly due to our dependence on both domestic and international sourcing. We aim to reduce import dependence by promoting domestic production of palm oil while simultaneously expanding our presence in international markets, enhancing supply chain resilience and supporting sustainable growth.

To address this risk, we are focusing on reducing import dependence by promoting domestic production of key raw materials. This includes capitalizing on domestic oil palm expansion programs to reduce import dependency and aggressively increasing the oil palm planted area. Additionally, we are enhancing supply chain resilience through strategic sourcing and fostering strong relationships with local suppliers.
Slowdown in economic activity could impact the FMCG industry and sales. Volatility in interest rates may affect financial performance and lead to investment losses.
Align product portfolio with a mix of premium, mass, and economy segment products, manage interest rate risk, and maintain adequate liquidity.

Foreign currency fluctuations and commodity price changes impact financial performance due to import dependency. Business disruption from geopolitical events may occur. The Company aims to reduce import dependence through domestic production l. This initiative aligns with changing consumer preferences and global demand for sustainable products.
Minimize import dependency, expand domestic oil palm plantation, and increase exports to create a natural foreign currency hedge.
Enhancing corporate governance improves business transformation and reputation.
Establish and implement internal policies and improve compliances.
Tracking consumer trends and strengthening dealer networks improve brand reach and cater to changing preferences.
Constantly analyse the market, selecting the best suppliers and venture into promising markets.
